summary: Michal fell about 60 feet when a handhold broke loose while he and his uncle Martin were traversing a Tenmile Range ridge while training for a 120-mile six-day stage race; he sustained serious injuries and could not move from where he landed, prompting a multi-agency rescue.
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Flight for Life; Air National Guard; St. Anthony Summit Medical Center
notes: Date approximate: 2018; listed as first of year. Exact date not published; the daughter's fundraiser says the accident was "last year" relative to a June 2019 race and links the Summit Daily article (article page not retrievable by the worker). He missed the race due to his injuries.
